characters.bio: Ian's voice was cloned from a fifteen-second reading and trained to narrate across many languages while keeping the same human warmth. He reads the way a patient teacher does: slow enough to think with, honest with the silences, never theatrical. Ian narrates most of the Corpora catalog — history, science, scripture, short fiction.

characters.tagline: A native voice of the Muses.
characters.bio: Aoede is the Greek muse of voice and song. Here she stands in for a class of native, provider-rendered voices — voices that have no single human source recording behind them, but emerge whole from the model. The Aoede voice is rendered by Google's Gemini speech synthesis. She narrates a small but growing slice of the Corpora catalog where a non-cloned voice serves the work.

books.title: The Mystery of Monte Albán
books.description: An illustrated investigation of the great Zapotec city built on a leveled hilltop in Oaxaca — why it rose, why it was abandoned, and what its carved stones still refuse to tell us.

books.title: Genesis (בראשית)
books.description: The first book of the Hebrew Bible — creation, the garden, the flood, the patriarchs. Read across many languages.

books.title: You Are the Goalkeeper
books.description: Read along as a young goalkeeper — angles, footwork, courage. Part of the U10 7v7 Soccer series.

books.title: You Are the Sweeper
books.description: Read along as a young sweeper — reading the play, holding the line, calm under pressure. Part of the U10 7v7 Soccer series.

books.title: You Are the Defender
books.description: Read along as a young defender — tackling, marking, communication. Part of the U10 7v7 Soccer series.

books.title: You Are the Striker
books.description: Read along as a young striker — first touch, finishing, finding space. Part of the U10 7v7 Soccer series.

books.title: What Is an Atom
books.description: A friendly first walk through the structure of matter — protons, neutrons, electrons, and the empty space between them.

books.description: An investigation of the earliest great Mesoamerican civilization, told through their colossal stone heads.

books.title: Zheng Yi Sao: The Pirate Queen of the South China Sea

books.title: Volcanoes

books.title: What Men Live By (Чем люди живы)
